title: Samsung Galaxy S9+ Dual VoLTE enabled, plus what is Dual VoLTE?
description: Samsung Galaxy S9 and S9+ got a new update that enabled dual VoLTE support. In this video I have explained what Dual VoLTE is and what happens when dual VoLTE is not enabled.  Samsung Galaxy S9+ review - https://youtu.be/daCHZtI3TJ4  I also updated the handset my Samsung Galaxy S9+, the latest software update now enabled Dual VoLTE and VoWiFi (Voice over Wi-Fi).  The update size if 426MB. If you are using the Samsung Galaxy S9 or the S9+ you might have got the update notification. Update the handset and after that dual VoLTE will be enabled.   Samsung Galaxy S9 / S9+ in India is using Exynos octa core processor and it did not have dual VoLTE support until now, latest update adds the support.  Without Dual VoLTE support on Samsung Galaxy S9+ I was not able to use JIO SIM when I enabled data on my airtel SIM, since after enabling data on airtel SIM slot the JIO SIM slot will become 3G/2G and since JIO needs 4G the SIM will not work.  But with this Samsung Galaxy S9+ dual VoLTE support I am now able to use both SIM together, in fact you can use 2 JIO SIMs together. Now both SIM 1 and SIM 2 slot support 4G together.
